lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill region, organized into roughly six identifiable vertical columns and three primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with faint horizontal lines of similar luminance; the high-intensity circular blobs are situated at the precise intersection points of these linear features.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the central ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient where high-intensity pixels on the upper edge transition to a low-intensity shadow region directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 12 high-luminance spots, with a higher spatial density and smaller diameter observed toward the posterior trailing edge compared to the base.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a unique patterning characterized by a significantly higher density of small, high-luminance pixel clusters compared to the larger, more widely spaced clusters found on the primary lateral flank.
